integrity: Analytic marked-frame theorem; executable finite arithmetic and randomized reconstruction tests support but cannot certify infinite-dimensional quantifiers. The rank-one and full-row-rank boundary specializations were previously established; novelty assessment concerns exact intermediate-rank spectral coupling. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
limitations: Fixed positive-definite left-curvature real matrix quadratic, exact nuclear-norm-scaled polar update, worst-case single-step ratio, prescribed rank. At rank above one extremal ratios are limiting suprema, not attained. The geometric one-step factor need not be sharp along any infinite trajectory. No stochastic, inexact-polar or learning-system claim.
title: Sharp rank-conditioned contraction frontier for nuclear-scaled polar descent
